annotations.title: Turn an inbox item into a draft

description: Turn a synced audience comment or Google Business Profile review from inbox_list into a new social post draft tagged "from-inbox" (Studio and Pro). Never publishes automatically; show the draft to the user before publishing or scheduling.

accountIds.description: Optional connected account ids from accounts_list for the new draft. Defaults to the inbox item’s own account.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: The inbox item id from inbox_list to turn into a new post draft.

tags.description: Optional campaign tags (up to 10 short names such as "spring-launch" or "webinar") for grouping posts in Results and expanding {tag} in UTM links. Stored only here; never posted.

text.description: Optional post wording for the new draft. Left out, a starter quote from the comment or review is generated.

title.description: Optional draft title (up to 200 characters). Left out, a title is built from the author name.

name: inbox_to_draft
title: Turn an inbox item into a draft
